question_text: Write a summary of the passage in not more than
stimulus: words. 10 Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below (4 & 5). Mominul Islam is a well-known village doctor in the village Tarapur under Rajshahi district. As a student, he was extraordinary. He is a private practitioner for the helpless villagers. He studied in pharmacy. He had a soft corner for the diseased people of the village. For this purpose, he worked for several years as a compounder under a qualified doctor. After that, he started serving the sick villagers. He has a dispensary at his home. His stock of medicine is enriched but he takes minimum amount from the patient for those. He is very active with his service. He rises early in the morning, sits at the dispensary and starts examining the patients. When he goes outside to visit a serious patient, he carries a bag full of medicine, a stethoscope, and other necessaries. Usually, he visits the patients by motor-bike. But for the rough areas, he solely depends on his feet. He is so sympathetic that even at the middle of night, he does not feel disturbance in consulting the patients. He is very kind to his poor patients. If he wanted, he could make money by getting a job with high salary. But all that he wanted was to be connected with his roots, with the people around him. This bonding leads him to do something for the community people. He is an idol for us in respect of social and national development.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Jashore Board-2016 (Test Paper 127-150)
